case: Exact rust_decimal representable boundaries across parser, parameter and PostgreSQL consumers
contract: Accept positive and negative maximum rust_decimal mantissas and the maximum scale of 28 without changing their text.
Reject one-step-over magnitude and scale in the explicit Decimal and grid parser paths.
Keep over-i64 integer input as text for Auto parameter mode instead of guessing Decimal.
Round-trip each supported edge through PostgreSQL bound NUMERIC and rendered SQL literal; compare native numeric::text and result type.

checks.command: rtk cargo clippy --locked -p tablepro-core -p tablepro-app -p tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

scope_limit: This proves the supported rust_decimal scalar boundary paths. It does not change wide PostgreSQL NUMERIC or BSON Decimal128 text/tag fallbacks, and it does not test a DECIMAL(28,8) column at these wider bounds.
status: Focused parser, parameter, PostgreSQL bound/literal and lint checks passed; B3 remains open.
